name: Hinjewadi
civicNote: Outside PMC and PCMC: governed by MIDC, PMRDA and gram panchayats. A merger into PCMC was approved in principle in 2025 but had not taken effect as of September 2026.
summary: A suburb north-west of Pune, best known for the Rajiv Gandhi Infotech Park. It sits outside both municipal corporations.
knownFor: Rajiv Gandhi Infotech Park (MIDC), about 2,800 acres in three phases
Offices of major IT firms such as Infosys, Wipro, TCS and Cognizant
connectivity: Pune Metro Line 3 (Hinjewadi-Shivajinagar) starts here, opening in phases from November 2026
Mumbai-Pune Expressway lies close to Hinjewadi
suits: IT professionals working in the Rajiv Gandhi Infotech Park who want to live close to their offices.
